description: Re-attempt deliveries that FAILED. Choose exactly one target: responseIds (repair specific rows), destinationKey (everything queued for one destination, from fillo_delivery_status), deliveryKind + deliveryId (one attempt), or all=true (the whole failed backlog on this form). Only failed work is retried, so this cannot double-send what already arrived — that is what makes it routine. Needs responses:manage.

all.description: Retry every failed delivery on this form.

destinationKey.description: A destination key from fillo_delivery_status, e.g. `webhook:abc`.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_retry_deliveries
title: Retry failed deliveries
